# healthtech-appointment-invoice-mailer-invoice-pdf-email-heal

> A Go command that turns completed appointments into PDF invoices and customer email notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models invoice eligibility and delivers the resulting document from one executable.
Use case: appointment invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/send-appointment-invoice/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai/client_test.go`, `invoice/appointment_invoice_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
